description: This Java source file defines a custom watch face service for Android Wear OS devices, featuring an analog watch with a sweep second hand and dynamic color theming based on background image palette extraction.

classes.name: SweepWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService, responsible for creating the watch face engine.

classes.name: SweepWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, implementing drawing logic, lifecycle methods, and handling watch face configurations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face, sets style, loads resources, and configures paints and palettes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles rendering the watch face, drawing background, tick marks, hour, minute, second hands, and managing ambient modes.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface dimension changes, recalculates hand lengths, scales backgrounds, and creates monochrome versions for ambient mode.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Triggers redraw every minute in interactive mode.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts display and styling based on ambient mode state.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Updates properties like low-bit ambient or burn-in protection settings.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Registers or unregisters receivers based on visibility of the watch face.
